title: OpenAI appoints Dali Rajic as Chief Revenue Officer
summary: OpenAI appoints Dali Rajic as Chief Revenue Officer to lead its global revenue organization and help businesses realize the full value of AI.
body: OpenAI appoints Dali Rajic as Chief Revenue Officer to lead its global revenue organization and help businesses realize the full value of AI.
summaryZh: OpenAI宣布任命Dali Rajic担任公司首席营收官（CRO）。他将全面领导OpenAI的全球营收与商业化组织，协助全球企业客户更好地评估和实现人工智能技术的业务价值。
